<div class="page-intro">

I frame problems, align people around the outcome and enable teams to deliver work that improves decisions and business results.

I combine business context, analytical judgment and practical execution. I take accountability for outcomes while giving people the trust, context and space to contribute their expertise and grow.

</div>

---

::: {.leadership-grid}

::: {.leadership-card}

### Direction

I turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem frames, measurable outcomes and prioritized analytical roadmaps.

In fast-moving environments, I test assumptions early, negotiate trade-offs and align stakeholders on scope, priorities, ownership and decision criteria. I also reuse proven approaches, existing assets and prior learning when they can accelerate progress.

**In practice:** I have aligned Product, Commercial, Engineering, BI and Analytics stakeholders around shared metrics, priorities, delivery plans and executive review mechanisms.

:::

::: {.leadership-card}

### Team management

I take accountability for team outcomes while creating the conditions for people to do their best work.

I align responsibilities with individual strengths and development goals, set clear expectations and remove obstacles without prescribing every step. I encourage direct, respectful challenge while keeping discussions focused and ensuring the team leaves with clear direction.

**In practice:** I have led multidisciplinary analytics and data science teams with highly specialized expertise, combining strong individual contributions with shared accountability for delivery and business results.

:::

::: {.leadership-card}

### Leverage

I look beyond individual analyses to build capabilities that can be reused across teams.

Depending on the need, this may include standardized metrics, automated reporting, self-service tools or recurring decision processes. I use Agile and Scrum practices selectively to improve transparency, ownership and delivery momentum—not as objectives in themselves.

**In practice:** I have scaled KPI reporting, led BI automation and established analytical processes and tools used across multiple teams.

:::

::: {.leadership-card}

### Influence

I translate business questions into analytical work and analytical findings into clear choices, implications and recommendations.

I adapt the level of detail to the audience and communicate uncertainty and trade-offs without losing the underlying reasoning.

**In practice:** I have aligned stakeholders around marketing experiments, explained A/B testing to non-technical audiences and built confidence in evidence-based decision-making. I have also supported executive reviews, roadmap decisions and cross-functional launches.

:::

::: {.leadership-card .leadership-card-wide}

### Quality

I make assumptions, limitations and uncertainty explicit so stakeholders understand what the evidence does—and does not—support.

I establish practical standards for metric definitions, validation, reproducibility and appropriate causal claims. The level of rigor should reflect the importance and reversibility of the decision.

**In practice:** I have owned business-critical metrics developed by my team, ensuring that definitions reflected business needs, were applied consistently across teams and were used correctly in decision-making. I have also established measurement frameworks and analytical standards to support consistent interpretation.

:::

:::

::: {.team-expectations}

### What teams can expect from me

- Clear priorities and ownership
- Accountability without micromanagement
- Direct, respectful feedback
- Space to challenge assumptions
- Responsibilities aligned with strengths and development goals
- Pragmatism about when to reuse, adapt or build
- A strong connection between analytical quality and business value

:::
